title: Mandate 74: the tool pulls the latest remote at start and resume
goal: CEO decision 2026-11-12: the tool pulls the latest remote when an agent starts or resumes work. State it in Mandate 74 (.agents/identity.json), AGENTS.md and docs/ceo-mandate-74.md: `susi-commercial workflow check` and `workflow fresh --pull` merge origin/main into a worktree with no uncommitted changes and never touch one that has. The implementation is Commercial T-CLAUDECOMMAUTOPULL-1. Text only.
limitations: Text only; the pull runs only when the agent runs one of the named commands (there is no session-start hook).
